explanation: In 1849 Dostoevsky stood before a firing squad, until a last-minute reprieve from the Tsar sent him to a Siberian prison camp instead.

claims.text: Fyodor Dostoevsky wrote Crime and Punishment.
Leo Tolstoy, Nikolai Gogol and Ivan Turgenev did not write Crime and Punishment.
In 1849 Dostoevsky faced a firing squad, but a reprieve from the Tsar commuted his death sentence at the last moment.
After the reprieve, Dostoevsky was sent to a prison camp in Siberia.
